DLC2317:4:t_004:0.en:
$$マオ$$
「Damn! We shot down the same number!」

DLC2317:4:t_004:1.en:
$$クラン$$
「The numbers may say it was a draw, but $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ wins on performance!」

DLC2317:4:t_004:3.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Well, the team results make my sniper duel with $$ミシェル$$ a draw, but I win hands down in the looks department.」

DLC2317:4:t_004:4.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「What kind of judging criteria are you using!? Obviously I win!」

DLC2317:4:t_005:0.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「How dare you do that to the $$暁の疾風旅団$$'s elite troops!」

DLC2317:4:t_005:1.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「Now I'll crush you with every last unit we've been holding in reserve!」

DLC2317:4:t_005:2.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「You bastards! S-L-A-U-G-H-T-E-R... I'll slaughter every last one of you!」

DLC2317:4:t_005:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「Their leader's a $$ファイヤバグ$$ survivor!」

DLC2317:4:t_005:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「Apparently they became separated from the main force and sank to banditry.」

DLC2317:4:t_005:5.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「Shut up! We've got a fine name: the $$暁の疾風旅団$$!」

DLC2317:4:t_005:6.en:
$$アルト$$
「The name's the only fine thing about you.」

DLC2317:4:t_005:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「Your opponents are $$ミスリル$$ and $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$... $c will deal with you.」

DLC2317:4:t_006:0.en:
$$オズマ$$
「What the hell are you doing!?」

DLC2317:4:t_006:2.en:
$$クラン$$
（From the look of things, that idiot $$ルカ$$ told him the whole truth...!）

DLC2317:4:t_006:3.en:
$$オズマ$$
「I don't mind you deciding to deploy on your own! But don't bring your personal squabbles onto the battlefield!」

DLC2317:4:t_006:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「With all due respect, Major... There are no personal squabbles among us.」

DLC2317:4:t_006:6.en:
$$アルト$$
「We've been working together on an operation to eliminate a criminal organization.」

DLC2317:4:t_006:7.en:
$$オズマ$$
「...Very well. Judging by your behavior, you don't appear to be lying.」

DLC2317:4:t_006:8.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「The operation is still in progress. From here on, we will coordinate our units' attacks.」

DLC2317:4:t_006:11.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Get moving! The enemy isn't going to wait for you!」

DLC2317:4:t_006:13.en:
$$クルツ$$
「We have no choice! Pair up with whoever's closest!」

DLC2317:4:t_007:0.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, eliminate the terrorists at once.」

DLC2317:4:t_007:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「This is a joint operation between $$ミスリル$$ and $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ Show those scoundrels our strength.」

DLC2317:4:t_007:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「You're in for it now, you bastards!」

DLC2317:4:t_008:1.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「After a thrashing that thorough, they won't be causing any more trouble.」

DLC2317:4:t_008:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「I thought it would be a boring night, but this has provided some stimulation.」

DLC2317:4:t_008:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「Yeah. Now I'll be able to sleep like a log once our watch is over.」

DLC2317:4:t_008:4.en:
$$クラン$$
（They changed their tune so quickly...）

DLC2317:4:t_008:5.en:
$$マオ$$
（$$アルト$$ isn't the only one who's a hell of an actor. So is $$宗介$$...）

DLC2317:4:t_009:0.en:
$$マオ$$
「Let's keep this up and hit them hard!」

DLC2317:4:t_009:1.en:
$$マオ$$
（$$テッサ$$'s giving it everything she's got! We soldiers have to protect $$ミスリル$$'s name too!）

DLC2317:4:t_010:0.en:
$$クラン$$
「Enemy shot down, confirmed! On to the next!」

DLC2317:4:t_010:1.en:
$$クラン$$
（$$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ is the bond between $$ミシェル$$ and me! I will protect that name, no matter what!）

DLC2317:4:t_100:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「You hicks have no idea what is happening in the world...! I'll show you what it means to be a frog down a hole!」

DLC2317:4:t_100:1.en:
$$アル$$
「Correction. The expression is 'a frog in a well.'」

DLC2317:4:t_100:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「...It means the same thing! Use a little discretion!」

DLC2317:4:t_101:0.en:
$$マオ$$
「Let's go, $$クルツ$$, $$宗介$$! We'll show $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ and those crooks that $$ミスリル$$ is still here!」

DLC2317:4:t_101:1.en:
$$マオ$$
「Listen up, you bastards! Big Sister $$マオ$$'s playing a little rough tonight!」

DLC2317:4:t_102:0.en:
$$クルツ$$
「This is a good opportunity to teach $$ミシェル$$ who $c's number one sniper is!」

DLC2317:4:t_102:1.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I'll take the title of King of Handsome while I'm at it!」

DLC2317:4:t_103:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「We're not about to fall behind the likes of them!」

DLC2317:4:t_103:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「With the Empire and $$アマルガム$$ running rampant, we don't need you running wild too! We're taking you down right here!」

DLC2317:4:t_104:0.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Looks like it's finally time to settle this handsome sniper contest between $$クルツ$$ and me.」

DLC2317:4:t_104:1.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「I'll take down every enemy and sweep every girl off her feet! I'm not giving up my place as the number one sniper!」

DLC2317:4:t_105:0.en:
$$クラン$$
「$$ミシェル$$, $$アルト$$! Follow me!」

DLC2317:4:t_105:1.en:
$$クラン$$
「Listen well, you scoundrels! It is we of $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ who will crush your ambitions!」

DLC2317:4:t_106:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「You mean our two-man team training?」

DLC2317:4:t_106:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「That was when we first started working together, wasn't it?」

DLC2317:4:t_106:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「We've known each other a long time now.」

DLC2317:4:t_106:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「But I would like our relationship as comrades in arms to end soon.」

DLC2317:4:t_106:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「Same here! Being classmates and clubmates is plenty for me!」

DLC2317:4:t_107:1.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「What are you talking about!? That's supposed to be your job!」

DLC2317:4:t_107:2.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Snipers are always stuck playing support! Let me take the lead when I'm paired with another sniper, at least!」

DLC2317:4:t_108:0.en:
$$マオ$$
「$$宗介$$ and $$アルト$$ have betrayed us! Now we'll have to settle this ourselves!」

DLC2317:4:t_108:1.en:
$$クラン$$
「Just what I wanted, Second Lieutenant $$マオ$$! I will uphold $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$'s reputation!」

DLC2317:4:t_108:2.en:
$$マオ$$
「A clash of women's pride! I can't afford to lose this one!」

DLC2317:4:t_109:0.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「You have my sympathies, Major $$オズマ$$. I can only imagine the strain of keeping such distinctive personalities in line.」

DLC2317:4:t_109:1.en:
$$オズマ$$
「They're my dear subordinates. A little stupidity from them isn't any trouble at all.」

DLC2317:4:t_109:2.en:
$$オズマ$$
「That's something I learned raising $$ランカ$$, too.」

DLC2317:4:t_109:3.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「My respect for you only continues to grow.」

DLC2317:4:t_109:4.en:
$$オズマ$$
「You're part of my family now too, $$ブレラ$$. I'll be counting on you!」

DLC2317:4:t_110:0.en:
$$ルカ$$
「That's strange... $$アルト$$ and $$宗介$$ seemed so hostile before they deployed...」

DLC2317:4:t_110:1.en:
$$カナリア$$
「Sometimes you're too close to see things clearly.」
